enums.name: ServiceOperationState
enums.description: The state reported for a recoverable Service operation. Unknown is a lookup result, not a stored execution outcome.

values.name: Unknown
values.description: No record is disclosed for this lookup. This does not establish whether work ran or may still be admitted.

values.name: Pending
values.description: The operation is admitted and has no committed final outcome.

values.name: OutcomeAvailable
values.description: An immutable original response or terminal protocol outcome is available.

values.name: Acknowledged
values.description: The Client acknowledged the available outcome and its payload was released.

values.name: Abandoned
values.description: The Client waived result recovery. This state does not establish that work stopped.

values.name: Expired
values.description: The result-retention interval elapsed and its payload was released.

enums.name: ServiceOperationOutcome
enums.description: The kind of committed outcome. A protocol outcome does not fabricate an original Service response.

values.name: None
values.description: No final outcome is reported.

values.name: ServiceResponse
values.description: The original Service produced a complete response or ServiceFault.

values.name: ExecutionDeadlineExceeded
values.description: The execution allowance ended before an outcome was committed. Effects may remain unknown.

values.name: ResultUnavailable
values.description: The original response could not be retained within the accepted encoding or message limits.

enums.name: ServiceOperationControlAction
enums.description: An explicit control action for one Server token.

values.name: Unspecified
values.description: Invalid in a request.

values.name: Cancel
values.description: Request cancellation of owned work without abandoning its outcome or implying rollback.

values.name: Acknowledge
values.description: Confirm Client acceptance of an available outcome and release its payload.

values.name: Abandon
values.description: Waive result recovery without requesting cancellation of work.

enums.name: ServiceOperationControlResult
enums.description: The disposition of a well-formed, authorized control request.

values.name: Unspecified
values.description: Invalid in a response.

values.name: Applied
values.description: The requested state change or cancellation signal was applied.

values.name: AlreadyApplied
values.description: The same action was applied previously; no new change was made.

values.name: NotApplicable
values.description: The action cannot be applied to the reported state; no new change was made.

values.name: UnknownOperation
values.description: No record is disclosed for the token; this is not proof of earlier acknowledgement or non-execution.

enums.name: ServiceOperationAuditAction
enums.description: An action recorded by the privileged operation audit.

values.name: Admitted
values.description: Identity and resources were committed before dispatch.

values.name: OutcomeCommitted
values.description: An immutable outcome became available.

values.name: CancellationRequested
values.description: A cancellation signal was recorded; stopping is not asserted.

values.name: Acknowledged
values.description: The available outcome was acknowledged.

values.name: Abandoned
values.description: The result was abandoned.

values.name: Expired
values.description: The result-retention interval ended.

values.name: Rejected
values.description: Submission was rejected without a new dispatch.

values.name: Denied
values.description: A request was denied by authorization or Session checks.

values.name: Collected
values.description: An available outcome was selected for delivery.

values.name: SessionClosed
values.description: The issuing Session ended and its recoverable state was discarded.

values.name: HistoryForgotten
values.description: The bounded terminal record was removed.

values.name: InvocationEnded
values.description: Owned invocation resources were released after the invocation actually ended, possibly after a protocol deadline.

structures.name: ServiceOperationInfoDataType
structures.description: Operation identity, state and remaining intervals. It contains no original response payload.

fields.name: ClientOperationId
fields.description: The accepted Client ID. An unknown Client-ID lookup echoes the requested ID; an unknown token lookup reports a null Guid.

fields.name: ServerToken
fields.description: The opaque token, between 1 and 64 bytes for a known record; null for an unknown lookup.

fields.name: ServiceId
fields.description: The DataType NodeId of the original request, or a null NodeId for an unknown lookup.

fields.name: State
fields.description: The disclosed operation state or Unknown lookup result.

fields.name: OutcomeKind
fields.description: The committed outcome kind; None while pending or unknown.

fields.name: OutcomeStatus
fields.description: The original serviceResult for ServiceResponse, or the terminal protocol error. Good with OutcomeKind None carries no business-success claim.

fields.name: ExecutionAllowance
fields.description: The accepted execution allowance in milliseconds; zero for an unknown lookup.

fields.name: ResultRetentionTime
fields.description: The accepted result and subsequent history interval in milliseconds; zero for an unknown lookup.

fields.name: ExecutionRemaining
fields.description: Nonnegative remaining execution allowance while Pending; otherwise zero.

fields.name: ResultRemaining
fields.description: Nonnegative remaining result retention while OutcomeAvailable; otherwise zero.

fields.name: HistoryRemaining
fields.description: Nonnegative remaining terminal-history retention after release; otherwise zero.

fields.name: CancellationRequested
fields.description: A cancellation signal has been requested. This is not confirmation that work stopped.

fields.name: RetryAfter
fields.description: Nonnegative advisory delay while Pending, no greater than ExecutionRemaining and strictly less than ResultRetentionTime when positive; zero for every other state.

structures.name: SubmitServiceRequest
structures.description: Submit one eligible original Service request under the recoverable contract.

fields.name: RequestHeader
fields.description: Standard parameters for this submission exchange.

fields.name: ClientOperationId
fields.description: A fresh nonzero random Client operation ID.

fields.name: Request
fields.description: An ExtensionObject containing exactly one eligible original Service request.

fields.name: ExecutionAllowance
fields.description: Exact positive finite milliseconds from admission to outcome commitment.

fields.name: ResultRetentionTime
fields.description: Exact positive finite milliseconds of result retention, then the same interval for terminal history.

fields.name: WaitTime
fields.description: Nonnegative finite maximum wait for this exchange; zero requests current state without parking a waiter.

structures.name: SubmitServiceResponse
structures.description: The admitted operation state and any available original response.

fields.name: ResponseHeader
fields.description: Standard response parameters for this exchange, independent of the original Service outcome.

fields.name: Operation
fields.description: The admitted identity, exact lifetime values and state.

fields.name: Result
fields.description: The immutable complete original response when State is OutcomeAvailable and OutcomeKind is ServiceResponse; otherwise a null ExtensionObject.

structures.name: GetServiceResultRequest
structures.description: Recover or collect an operation using exactly one identifier.

fields.name: RequestHeader
fields.description: Standard parameters for this collection exchange.

fields.name: ClientOperationId
fields.description: A nonzero Client ID for recovery, or a null Guid when ServerToken is used.

fields.name: ServerToken
fields.description: A nonempty token of at most 64 bytes, or null when ClientOperationId is used. Supplying both or neither is invalid.

fields.name: WaitTime
fields.description: Nonnegative finite maximum wait for this exchange; zero means polling.

structures.name: GetServiceResultResponse
structures.description: A declared collection response containing state and an optional original response.

fields.name: ResponseHeader
fields.description: A fresh header for this collection exchange.

fields.name: Operation
fields.description: The operation snapshot or Unknown lookup result.

fields.name: Result
fields.description: The immutable complete original response when State is OutcomeAvailable and OutcomeKind is ServiceResponse; otherwise a null ExtensionObject.

structures.name: ControlServiceExecutionRequest
structures.description: Control one known operation using its Server-issued token.

fields.name: RequestHeader
fields.description: Standard parameters for this control exchange.

fields.name: ServerToken
fields.description: A nonempty Server token of at most 64 bytes; Client ID lookup is not a control action.

fields.name: Action
fields.description: Cancel, Acknowledge or Abandon; Unspecified and unrecognized values are invalid.

structures.name: ControlServiceExecutionResponse
structures.description: The disposition of a control action and the resulting operation metadata.

fields.name: ResponseHeader
fields.description: A fresh header for this control exchange.

fields.name: Result
fields.description: Whether the action was applied, already applied, not applicable or unknown.

fields.name: Operation
fields.description: The current disclosed metadata. This response never carries an original response payload.

objectTypes.name: AsyncServiceDiagnosticsType
objectTypes.description: Privileged aggregate diagnostics. There is no caller-visible operation list.

members.name: ActiveOperationCount
members.description: Owned invocations that have not actually ended, including those past their protocol deadline.

members.name: RetainedOutcomeCount

members.name: RetainedOutcomeBytes
members.description: Charged retained-outcome storage, including storage still leased to in-flight senders.

members.name: TerminalRecordCount
members.description: Retained metadata records after payload release, including required still-running-work identities.

members.description: Cumulative admitted operations.

members.name: RejectedCount

members.name: AcknowledgedCount
members.description: Cumulative first acknowledgements; retries do not increase this count.

members.name: AbandonedCount
members.description: Cumulative first abandonments; retries do not increase this count.

members.name: ExpiredCount
members.description: Cumulative result-retention expirations.

members.name: ExecutionDeadlineCount
members.description: Cumulative committed execution-deadline outcomes.

objectTypes.name: AuditServiceOperationEventType
objectTypes.description: Privileged audit metadata for recoverable operation actions. Tokens, credentials and copied request/result payloads are not fields of this event.

members.name: ClientOperationId
members.description: The Client correlation ID, or a null Guid when no operation was identified.

members.name: ServiceId
members.description: The original request DataType NodeId, when known.

members.name: Action
members.description: The action recorded by this event.

members.name: OperationState
members.description: The reported operation state or Unknown when no record is disclosed.

members.name: OutcomeKind
members.description: The recorded outcome kind, without the original response payload.

members.name: OutcomeStatus
members.description: The original serviceResult or terminal protocol error when known; the inherited audit Status reports success of the audited action separately.

instances.name: AsyncServiceCapabilities
instances.description: Recoverable execution capabilities under ServerCapabilities; absent when the feature is disabled.

methodHint.description: A read-only Property on a Method. Absence is undeclared, not false. True does not promise admission for every input or current resource/authorization state. Instance NodeIds are assigned by the Server.

statusRules.unknownAuthorizedLookup: Good with State Unknown and no payload
statusRules.unavailableOnCurrentTransport: BadResponseTooLarge without changing the retained outcome

invariants: Field order is wire order. No request or response changes the fixed standard header layouts.
All requests require an activated Session. IDs alone confer no access.
Admission checks and reservations precede the single original-Service dispatch.
Client ID is nonzero; Server token is 1..64 bytes for a known operation.
GetServiceResult supplies exactly one ID. ControlServiceExecution requires a Server token.
ExecutionAllowance and ResultRetentionTime are positive finite exact values; WaitTime is finite and nonnegative.
Original RequestHeader.timeoutHint does not impose a second framework deadline. Existing business timeouts and diagnostics/options retain their meanings.
Unknown metadata has OutcomeKind None, OutcomeStatus Good, zero lifetime fields, CancellationRequested false, RetryAfter zero and no Result.
Only OutcomeAvailable plus ServiceResponse carries Result. Protocol outcomes and released records carry a null Result.
OutcomeStatus for ServiceResponse is the original ResponseHeader.ServiceResult, not an assertion that every item succeeded.

A positive Pending RetryAfter is less than ResultRetentionTime as well as no greater than ExecutionRemaining, since an outcome could become ready immediately after the reply. Use zero when no positive safe advice is available.
Response headers belong to the current exchange; the original embedded response header and payload remain immutable.
DeadlineExceeded uses BadTimeout and never later changes to a late ServiceResponse.
Known released records preserve outcome metadata where it existed, not the original payload.
ACK of OutcomeAvailable applies; repeated ACK of Acknowledged is AlreadyApplied; ACK of Pending, Abandoned or Expired is NotApplicable.
Abandon applies to Pending or OutcomeAvailable; repeated Abandon of Abandoned is AlreadyApplied; other released states are NotApplicable.
Cancel applies when owned invocation work remains active and no cancellation signal was recorded; duplicate signals are AlreadyApplied. Stopped work is NotApplicable.
Every control for an undisclosed token returns UnknownOperation and Unknown metadata. Unspecified actions/results are invalid.
Terminal history lasts ResultRetentionTime from release; polling never renews it. Minimal active-work identity may remain longer until owned invocation work ends.
Authorization is checked before lookup disclosure, before control effects and again before delayed result delivery.
A denied or too-small delivery does not mutate the retained original outcome or dispatch it again.
Cumulative diagnostic counters saturate at UInt64 maximum rather than wrapping.
No new status-code allocations, result-size controls, policy selector, completion/progress event or per-owner operation enumeration are introduced.
